title: A tool with subcommands
hints: Look at args[0] to pick the subcommand, and give each one its own flag.NewFlagSet that parses args[1:].
For add, the task text is strings.Join(fs.Args(), " ") after parsing. An empty text is a usage error.
Every usage problem (no subcommand, an unknown one, bad flags, missing text) writes a message to stderr and returns 2.
